verdict.rationale: Vanta's API/docs show owner assignment on resources/controls (docs-23, docs-30) and a document evidence-attachment + review workflow (docs-31, docs-1), which covers part of the manual-artifact lifecycle. However, there is no explicit documentation of due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking specifically for manual (non-automated) evidence artifacts — the only reminder/workflow language found (docs-22) is scoped to risk assessments, not manual evidence expiry. Missing for 10: explicit due-date fields on manual evidence, renewal/expiry reminder scheduling for documents, and independent confirmation these fields exist in the UI.
